neighbours.label: words naming a technology or business sector as a modifier (digital, computational, financial services, software)
fire: The fund invests mainly in financial services and healthcare companies.
Our school added a course on digital literacy for younger pupils.
The lab develops computational methods for predicting protein shapes.
Many graduates now find work in software engineering and data analytics.
The trade fair focused on logistics and materials handling equipment.
She runs a small consultancy that advises firms on cloud computing.
The city hopes to attract investment in information technology.
Their report covers trends in online retail and digital payments.
quiet: The fund invests mainly in old farmland and family-owned vineyards.
Our school added a course on gardening for younger pupils.
The lab studies how birds choose places to build their nests.
Many graduates now find work in teaching and local nursing homes.
The country fair focused on cattle, horses and homemade jam.
She runs a small bakery that sells bread to the nearby cafes.
The city hopes to attract more tourists to its old harbour.
Their report covers trends in bird migration along the coast.

notes: card: ' computational', ' services' (financial services), ' Digital' (Literacy), 'Adobe', 'python', 'materials handling'. Mixed; guess is industry/tech sector naming. Quiet keeps sentences with non-sector modifiers.
